analyst: The entry is an RSI pullback trigger that opens a long when the session filter is active, close is above the VWMA, RSI recovers above the oversold level, the bar makes a low at or below the recent swing low while closing above its open, and the cooldown has elapsed. It opens a short when the session filter is active, close is below the VWMA, RSI falls below the overbought level, the bar makes a high at or above the recent swing high while closing below its open, and the cooldown has elapsed. Entries are blocked inside the skip window, and any open position is closed when that window starts or when the session ends. The stop is a fixed dollar stop, stop_dollars divided by point value, placed below the long entry or above the short entry, with an additional close if open profit reaches the negative stop amount.
